title: Make thumbnail/tooltip popup resizable by dragging on edges, as with traditional windows and many other Plasma popups
line: Task Manager tooltips with window thumbnails can now be resized by dragging their edges, like Kickoff and the system tray, and keep their new size.
explanation: Plasma tooltips always take the size of their content, and KWin refused to resize tooltip windows at all, so the task tooltip's fixed 16x8 grid-unit window thumbnails could not be made bigger. KWin now lets tooltips be resized like applet popups (still never maximized or tiled). libplasma's ToolTipArea gets an opt-in resizable mode: the tooltip reuses WindowResizeHandler (the same edge handling as applet popups, with the edges facing the panel excluded), follows the user's size while the edge is dragged, and reports the final size with a resized() signal. The task manager enables it only for thumbnail tooltips, lays out its windows to the dragged size live, and stores toolTipWidth and toolTipThumbnailHeight once when the resize ends.

commits.message:
xdgshellwindow: allow resizing tooltips like applet popups

Tooltips were never resizable, so a Plasma tooltip asking to be resized
from one of its edges was ignored. They can now be resized like applet
popups, which also keeps them from being maximized or tiled.

BUG: 526187

declarativeimports/core: allow resizing tooltips from their edges

Tooltips always took the size of their content. ToolTipArea gains an
opt-in resizable mode that lets the user drag the tooltip's free edges
like applet popups, reporting the new size so it can be remembered.

BUG: 526187

applets/taskmanager: make thumbnail tooltips resizable from their edges

Window thumbnails in task tooltips had a fixed size, too small to see
much on many screens. Thumbnail tooltips can now be resized by dragging
their free edges like Kickoff and the system tray, and the size is kept.

BUG: 526187

media.caption: Master: pressing the top edge of Dolphin's tooltip and dragging up does nothing, and the tooltip disappears once the pointer leaves it
With the change: the top edge and then the right edge are dragged and the tooltip and its thumbnail follow live; the Konsole group tooltip then uses the same size for each window
Master: the Konsole group tooltip at its fixed default size
With the change: the same group tooltip after plasmashell was restarted keeps the size chosen by dragging
